Ingredients:
<style="highlight">3 portions of longleaf amaranth</style>.

Discard the roots and stems, crush the leaves and berries of the longleaf amaranth to extract the juice, then boil with water.

疗伤药剂
配料：
<style="highlight">3份长叶苋草</style>
去除根茎不用，将长叶苋草的叶子和果实碾碎后滤出汁液，加水熬煮。
